questions.q: What is a restaurant customer data platform?
questions.a: A restaurant customer data platform (CDP) unifies guest data from every location and touchpoint into one profile per guest. It pulls in sources like POS, online ordering, reservations, loyalty, reviews and marketing. You can then segment guests, personalize outreach and drive repeat visits.

questions.q: What's the difference between a CDP and a customer database?
questions.a: A database holds raw records in separate tables, often one per location, and usually needs an analyst to query it. A CDP stitches those records into one profile per guest and matches the same guest across locations. It also gives marketing and operations teams an interface they can use without writing SQL.

questions.q: What can a CDP tell me about my guests?
questions.a: A CDP shows how your guest base is growing, how many guests become loyal regulars and which ones are lapsing or at risk. It tracks frequency, spend, recency and lifetime value, so you can see whether new guests are turning into higher spend. Some also tie satisfaction signals like NPS, CSAT and review sentiment to each profile.

questions.q: How does a CDP help with guest retention?
questions.a: A CDP flags at-risk and lapsed guests based on their visit behavior, then lets you trigger win-back campaigns by email or SMS. Because each guest has a single profile, you can tailor the offer to what they ordered and how often they came. That makes your outreach more relevant than a blanket promotion.

questions.q: How do I choose a customer data platform for my restaurant group?
questions.a: Start with the systems you already use and check that the CDP integrates with your POS, ordering, loyalty and reservation tools. Then decide what you need beyond unified profiles, such as predictive churn scores, revenue attribution or built-in loyalty and campaigns. Most restaurant CDPs use custom pricing based on locations and data volume.

questions.q: Which CDP connects guest data with feedback and reviews?
questions.a: Momos is a restaurant CDP that unifies data from POS, online ordering, reservations, reviews, email, SMS and social into one profile per guest across all locations. It segments guests by behavior, identifies at-risk and lapsed guests and triggers win-back campaigns. Satisfaction signals like NPS, CSAT and sentiment are tied to each profile.
